title: Tres Leches Cake Bars
description: A twist on the classic tres leches cake, these bars are moist and flavorful with a honeyed crust.
instructions: Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt; set aside.
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in honeyed cake mix until well combined.
Gradually add flour mixture, beating until just combined.
Pour batter into prepared baking dish and smooth top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Poke holes all over the top of the cake with a skewer or fork.
Drizzle evaporated milk, condensed milk, and heavy cream evenly over the top of the cake.
Let cool completely in pan before cutting into bars.
